column1: # Key for the Raince cipher of 25 Oct 1525 (Dupuy 452 ff.28r-29v), atlas codes of inventory.tsv -> plaintext.
# Solver worker, 24 Sept 2026. Base: Tomokiyo's reconstruction of Raince's 1526 cipher (cryptiana francis.htm,
# section "BnF fr.2984 (1526)", image francisRaince.png), as measured glyph by glyph by D. Bourdeau
# MIT code, CC BY 4.0 text). Mapping made by shape, contact_sheet.jpg against key_labelled.png.
# kind: letter | null | word (word sign) | open (not in the 1526 key, value not assigned)
# source: key = the 1526 key's glyph for this value, matched by shape (grade H);
#         print = value confirmed from known plaintext, Jacqueton, La politique extérieure de Louise de Savoie
#         (1892), P.J. XXXIII pp. 366-370, archive.org lapolitiqueext00jacquoft, printed from the contemporary
#         context = not in the 1526 key (or a different value), assigned from decoded context (grade S);
#         open = no value (grade U; shown in reading.txt as <code>).
# value: plaintext (lower case). Word signs are written in brackets, e.g. [con].
